views.note: How long the broker waits before it believes a node is gone.

views.label: Resume
views.note: The four steps that put the work back on a healthy node.

views.label: Checkpoint cadence
views.note: What the supervisor was writing while the node died.

events.title: The node dies
events.detail: Thermal kill, power loss or a pulled cable.

events.title: The socket closes, or the heartbeat stops
events.detail: Either the socket closes or the heartbeat goes silent; both are the same event to the broker.

events.title: The last checkpoint was committed
events.detail: Every 64 tokens or 10 seconds the supervisor writes a FaultRecoverySnapshot.

events.title: The watchdog declares the node LOST
events.detail: Silence past heartbeat.timeout_seconds. The node is quarantined for quarantine_seconds.

events.title: The newest snapshot is loaded
events.detail: The coordinator reads EdgeRecord, and falls back to the local journal when the ledger is down.

events.title: The snapshot is validated against the job
events.detail: Prompt hash and model must match, or the job restarts clean on the new node.

events.title: The job is re-dispatched
events.detail: Directly, not through the shared queue, and never onto the node that just failed.

events.title: Generation resumes from the decode step
events.detail: The recorded partial tokens are replayed, so the work already done is not repeated.

cards.title: These are the designed budgets
items: The times come from the documented fault timeline, not from a recorded incident
The evidence flag is illustrative on purpose: no trace was captured
The real detector is heartbeat.timeout_seconds, six seconds by default

cards.title: What the timeline protects
items: Detection costs the silence window, which is why the heartbeat interval is two seconds
The recovery work itself is under half a second in the design
The thirty-second recovery budget is the outer bound, not the expectation

cards.title: Where the plan still leaks
items: The quarantine never expires, so a node that failed once never returns to the pool
A transient socket drop fails the running job instead of waiting for the verdict
Phase 0 of the roadmap closes both
